purpose: Rebuild the unretained full Rust DWARF ELF and perform a fresh real Rust-entry debug boot, rather than pretending it was archived.
required_environment: CARGO_HOME and RUSTUP_HOME pointing to installed nightly-2026-07-21
VDSO_LIBRARY_DIR with the saved Linux VDSO
PATH includes task cargo/bin, installed cargo-binutils 0.4.0 and GDB
LD_LIBRARY_PATH when using the extracted GDB dependency root
actual_upstream_make_command: runs/03/readable/run/commands.json and raw log member run/boot/command.sh
exact_byte_rebuild_boundary: DWARF embeds absolute source/build paths. The command documents how to rebuild and re-exercise the artifact; no cross-host bit-for-bit rebuild is claimed.
